summary: NovaScope is an interactive web-based stars navigations based planetarium viewing concept that targeting students, educators or those who interested with space as the users. In NovaSpace, users can explore and coordinate stars, allow the user to discover the details of the universe that are invisible to the naked eye. By including different views from different timelines, users can switch between older and the latest available observations of the same region, witnessing how our view of the universe changes over the time. By comparing these observations, user can explore visual differences, investigate potential movements of astronomical objects, and learn more about the stars.
details:
INTRODUCTION TO PROJECT

NovaScope: Navigate the Stars, Explore the Universe is a interactive web-based stars navigator that inspired by the concept of planeterium.

The users can navigate through the STARS and choosing the star's name with it's coordinate to see the specific stars on the star map. The the descriptions of the stars will be appear.

To view the movement and timelapse of the stars, users can click on the arror button, either the left or right button, to see the past movement or the future movement.

Users can also view the journey of the stars, by choosing any options in the JOURNEY.

TIME-LAPSE JOURNEY provide the timelapse images of specific stars such as Barnard's Star.

FRONTEND VIEW

INTENDED IMPACT OF THE PROJECT

Our target for this project is to bring help students, educators or the first-time space enthusiast to easily navigate and view stars in the space. This project help the users to be able see the different timelapse of the stars from the past to the present time without having to go through complicated data.

ELEMENTS IN OUR PROJECT

Interactive Learning: Planetarium like view to navigate around the stars and to view the timelapses of the stars.

TOOLS AND CODING LANGUAGES

To develop this web-based stars navigator, we use:

  1. Claude.ai
  2. VS Studio Code
  3. Python
  4. HTML
  5. CSS
  6. Javascript
  7. Figma

To build a functioning website, we use Claude.ai to generate the code and use VS Sudio Code to edit and review the code's structure.

To build the frontend, we used HTML, CSS and Javascript. For the backend data, we use Python to gather some of the data from the NASA data and resourses.

We use Figma to to design an interesting visual for the frontend.

USE OF SUPER INTELLIGENCE (SI)

We use Super Intelligence (SI) tools including Google Gemini and Claude.ai for brainstorming, generate ideas, design inspiration and generate code structure in our project.

For more accurate and meaning data, we used the NASA data and resources that have been provided for this challange.
